_note: External damage amplifiers, values at 100% ability strength (wiki, read 2026-11-01). subsumedValue = Helminth version. Stacking: Roar is a faction-type bonus (additive with Bane/Expel mods, double-dips on status ticks, multiplicative with everything else); Eclipse multiplies almost all other damage buffs; Nourish works like an extra Viral mod.

buffs.name: Roar
buffs.note: Faction-type bonus vs every enemy: adds to Bane/Expel mods, counts twice on status ticks. Rhino 50%, subsumed 30%.

buffs.name: Eclipse (Solar)
buffs.note: Multiplicative with almost all other damage buffs. Mirage 200% at max rank, subsumed 30%.

buffs.name: Nourish
buffs.note: Works like an extra Viral mod. Grendel 75%, subsumed 45%.

buffs.name: Vex Armor (Fury, max)
buffs.note: Additive with Serration-type base damage mods. Verify value.

buffs.name: Xata's Whisper
buffs.note: Adds Void damage as its own element. Verify value.

buffs.name: Arcane Avenger
buffs.note: Additive with crit chance mods; assumes full uptime.
